en.title: Prism of Reverberations and the Village Lost in a Silver Melody
en.premise: The world is shaped by the melodies it plays, and dissonance invites disaster. When a 'Silent Village' vanishes from the map without a trace, the fates of three musicians intertwine: a pursuing musician, a songstress stripped of her memories, and a melody imprisoned within a mirror. When their voices finally harmonize, the long-lost chord of truth shall resonate across the world.

zh.title: 残响之棱镜与消失在银色旋律中的村庄
zh.premise: 世界由奏响的旋律构成，而不和谐音则会招致灾厄。某日，围绕着从地图上忽然消失的“无声之村”的谜团，三位演奏者的命运交织在一起。追寻真相的乐师、失去记忆的歌姬，以及被囚禁在镜中的旋律。当他们的歌声重叠之时，失落于世的真实和弦将响彻寰宇。
